name: ac-brand-guidelines
description: Codify corporate brand standards into a testable brand specification, build machine-checkable project style sheets, audit document corpuses against terminology and voice rules, detect recurring style slips, and run remediation passes with editorial sign-off. Use when asking "write our brand guidelines", "audit our docs against the brand", "does this match our style guide", "brand voice consistency", "terminology compliance", "our documents don't sound like us". Not for choosing a public style guide for one author's voice (use ac-voice-and-style), not for line-level copyediting of a draft (ac-editing), not for readability and inclusive language (ac-plain-language), not for creating marketing copy (ac-persuasive-writing).
